oracle: I6: exactly one version per base
what: commitDraft's transaction no longer checks that the base is still current (functions/src/lib/draft.ts "STALE"), so a commit that passed the endpoint's check before another published mints a second version on the same base

target.case: canary I6: a commit paused before choosing its version id while another publishes on the same base mints nothing, so v1 has one version
